# SEURAT subfunctions

```{r}
# used to compare different integration methods
# CellMixS (Bioconductor)
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("CellMixS")
```

```{r}
# LISI
# LISI (GitHub only, not on CRAN)
# if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("immunogenomics/LISI")
# installation fails due to 
# LISI's src/Makevars hardcodes CXX_STD = CXX11 (the package hasn't been touched since ~2019, when C++11 was still fine). But the RcppArmadillo version already on your system now requires C++14 — recent Armadillo versions use auto return-type deduction and constexpr features that don't exist in C++11, which is exactly what the errors ('accu' function uses 'auto' type specifier without trailing return type, deduced return type only available with -std=c++14) are complaining about. Rcpp/RcppArmadillo evolved past what LISI's build config expects; it's a compatibility gap in an unmaintained package, not something you did wrong.


# (https://github.com/immunogenomics/LISI/releases/tag/v1.0) # check for more recent versions
tar_path <- "/condo/brannanlab/VS_share/VS_AS_folder/PDXs_V3/analysis/LISI-1.0.tar.gz"

extract_dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(extract_dir)
untar(tar_path, exdir = extract_dir)

pkg_dir <- list.dirs(extract_dir, recursive = FALSE)[1]
cat("Extracted package dir:", pkg_dir, "\n")

makevars_path <- file.path(pkg_dir, "src", "Makevars")
lines <- readLines(makevars_path)
lines <- gsub("CXX_STD = CXX11", "CXX_STD = CXX14", lines)
writeLines(lines, makevars_path)

# clear the stale lock from the earlier interrupted install, just in case
# unlink("/home/tmhaxs421/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/4.5/00LOCK-Rcpp", recursive = TRUE)

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_local(pkg_dir, force = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# FASTMNN required packages

# Not installed in this environment (SeuratWrappers, batchelor). Run this
# chunk manually if you want FastMNN as a 6th integration method, then set
# run_fastmnn <- TRUE below and re-knit.

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("batchelor")
if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("satijalab/seurat-wrappers")
```
